activity_state.help:
Status based on activities
Overdue: Due date is already passed
Today: Activity date is today
Planned: Future activities.

activity_exception_decoration.help: Type of the exception activity on record.

activity_exception_icon.help: Icon to indicate an exception activity.

message_needaction.help: If checked, new messages require your attention.

message_has_error.help: If checked, some messages have a delivery error.

message_has_error_counter.help: Number of messages with delivery error

message_has_sms_error.help: If checked, some messages have a delivery error.

create_invoice_in_vnd_only.help: Create Invoice in VND Only (Can edit currency rate manually)

mark_is_paid.help: Tick when small rounding residual remains after foreign currency payment.

settled_by_offset.help: Note đã được cấn trừ công nợ trên SOA Debt Offset. Coi như đã tất toán, không xuất hóa đơn/bill riêng nữa.

list.arch:
<tree default_order="date desc" create="0" decoration-danger="is_near_due == True">
<!--                    <header>-->
<!--                        <button name="action_add_to_soa" type="object" string="Add to SOA" class="btn-primary"/>-->
<!--                        <button string="Cancel" special="cancel"/>-->
<!--                    </header>-->
                    <field name="name" modifiers="{"readonly": true, "required": true}"/>
                    <field name="partner_id" on_change="1" modifiers="{"required": true}"/>
                    <field name="shipper_id" modifiers="{"readonly": true}"/>
                <field name="consignee_id" modifiers="{"readonly": true}"/>
                    <field name="job_id" on_change="1" modifiers="{"readonly": true}"/>
                    <field name="house_id" optional="hide" on_change="1" modifiers="{"readonly": true}"/>
                    <field name="house_bl_display" modifiers="{"readonly": true}"/>
                <field name="eta_job" optional="show" modifiers="{"readonly": true}"/>
                <field name="etd_job" optional="show" modifiers="{"readonly": true}"/>
                <field name="carrier_id" optional="show" modifiers="{"readonly": true}"/>
                <field name="pol_display" optional="show" modifiers="{"readonly": true}"/>
                <field name="pod_display" optional="show" modifiers="{"readonly": true}"/>
                <field name="etd_job" optional="show" modifiers="{"readonly": true}"/>
                    <field name="date" on_change="1" modifiers="{"required": true}"/>
                    <field name="due_date" optional="show" on_change="1"/>
                    <field name="salesman_id" optional="show" modifiers="{"readonly": true}"/>
                    <field name="amount_total" sum="Total" on_change="1" modifiers="{"readonly": true}"/>
                    <field name="amount_total_foreign" sum="Total (Foreign)" optional="show" modifiers="{"readonly": true}"/>
                    <field name="paid_amount" sum="Paid Amount" optional="show" on_change="1" modifiers="{"readonly": true}"/>
                    <field name="amount_residual" sum="Residual Amount" optional="show" on_change="1" modifiers="{"readonly": true}"/>
                    <field name="activity_ids" widget="list_activity"/>
                    <field name="create_uid" modifiers="{"readonly": true}"/>
                    <field name="create_date" modifiers="{"readonly": true}"/>
                    <field name="company_id" optional="show" on_change="1" modifiers="{"required": true}"/>
                    <field name="state" widget="badge" decoration-danger="state == 'cancel'" decoration-warning="state == 'partial_invoiced'" decoration-success="state == 'invoiced'" on_change="1" modifiers="{"readonly": true, "required": true}"/>
                    <field name="payment_state" widget="badge" decoration-danger="payment_state == 'not_paid'" decoration-warning="payment_state in ('partial',)" decoration-success="payment_state in ('paid',)" optional="show" on_change="1" modifiers="{"readonly": true}"/>
                    <field name="currency_id" modifiers="{"readonly": true, "column_invisible": true}"/>
                    <field name="company_currency_id" modifiers="{"readonly": true, "column_invisible": true}"/>
                    <field name="foreign_currency_id" modifiers="{"readonly": true, "column_invisible": true}"/>
                <field name="is_near_due" modifiers="{"readonly": true, "column_invisible": true}"/>
                <header>
                    <button name="action_bulk_send_debit_note" type="object" string="Send" class="btn-primary"/>
                    <button name="action_bulk_cancel_debit_note" type="object" string="Cancel" class="btn-danger"/>
                    <button name="action_bulk_create_invoice_debit_note" type="object" string="Create Invoice" class="btn-primary"/>
                </header>
                </tree>

search.arch:
<search>
<field name="name"/>
<field name="partner_id"/>
<field name="job_id"/>
                <field name="remark" string="Remark" filter_domain="['|', ('remark', 'like', self), ('line_ids.remark', 'like', self)]"/>
                <field name="perf_date" string="Performance Date"/>
                <filter name="filter_perf_date" string="Performance Date" date="perf_date"/>
<filter name="ftr_for" string="Debit FOR" domain="['|', ('house_id', '!=', False), ('master_id', '!=', False)]"/>
<filter name="ftr_log" string="Debit LOG" domain="[('house_id', '=', False), ('master_id', '=', False)]"/>
                <separator/>
                <filter name="not_paid" string="Not Paid" domain="[('payment_state', '=', 'not_paid')]"/>
                <filter name="partial_paid" string="Partially Paid" domain="[('payment_state', '=', 'partial')]"/>
                <filter name="paid" string="Paid" domain="[('payment_state', '=', 'paid')]"/>
                <group string="Group By">
                    <filter string="Customer" name="group_by_partner_id" context="{'group_by': 'partner_id'}"/>
                    <filter string="Job" name="group_by_job_id" context="{'group_by': 'job_id'}"/>
                    <filter string="House B/L" name="group_by_house_id" context="{'group_by': 'house_id'}"/>
                </group>
</search>
